column5: Celebrate Taco Tuesday with a special taco bar featuring carne asada, chicken, and all the fixings. Come hungry!
It's National Waffle Day! Enjoy made-to-order waffles with a variety of sweet and savory toppings all day long.
Celebrate National Burrito Day with a build-your-own burrito station featuring fresh ingredients and bold flavors.
Join UTSA Dining for a festive Fiesta celebration with traditional Tex-Mex food, live music, and colorful decorations.
Celebrate Earth Day with a special sustainable menu featuring locally sourced ingredients and eco-friendly dining practices.
Show off your creativity at the Fiesta Cookie Decorating Contest! Decorate sugar cookies with Fiesta-inspired designs. Prizes awarded for best designs.
